searchText: Sorry I lied about `lighthouse:das` branch being devnet-1 ready 😅 the ENR change wasn't merged to `das` when the devnet was launched, but I've just merged it a few hours ago. (It should have minimal impact other than LH supernodes not being recognised as supernodes) i’ll bump them in a bit bumped No rush, I might have found a bug with our enr encoding I guess too late 🤣 <@466006586477772831> got a metrics endpoint where we could verify that the number of coulmns working? Also <@476250636548308992> <@531934490826768418> <@425907307621122049> any metrics endpoints for prysm/teku? For us you can fetch via 8080/metrics and just grep for `data_column` and you should see message counts for the subnets We don't have any PeerDAS metrics yet. What do we need? Something exposing column numbers of custody columns? Btw what's kind of node teku-geth-3 node, I see it's often orphaned. Is it normal node with regular settings? https://github.com/ethpandaops/peerdas-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-1/host_vars/teku-geth-3.yaml its the only non supernode Just a heads up in case anyone notices logs related to decoding lighthouse enrs, we've made a PR to fix the bug, and should be merged in the next day Can roll the image out if you want Thanks! The PR (https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/5997) is still under review - I can merge it tmr if no one has time to look at it. It shouldn't impact the network too much given we have multi client supernodes https://tenor.com/view/crazy-eyes-steve-buscemi-big-eyes-gif-14249327279284242293 I can roll out this PR to one of the nodes if you want The impact with mismatching enr format is LH will only recognise LH peers as supernodes and same for other other clients (they'll see LH supernodes as regular nodes) We can wait for a bit. I guess rolling this out to a LH supernode means one less supernode for LH nodes, and one more supernodes for other client nodes 😂 thanks though! just ping me when you want this to be rolled. Sure
